# Skeleton

Loading placeholders that copy the shape of the real layout, so nothing jumps when the data arrives.

`CLR.Skeleton` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.Skeleton />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.Skeleton"></x-import>
```

## Props (SkeletonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `number \| string` |  |
| `height` | `number \| string` |  |
| `radius` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'full'` |  |
| `shape` | `'text' \| 'gauge' \| 'tile' \| 'row' \| 'chart'` | Shapes that mirror the real layout: pass the component you are standing in for. |
